articles.title: Letter: St. Brendan’s Parish Did a Good Job This Winter
body: To the editor: I have lived on Mulberry Avenue for 8 years, and I want to say what a difference St. Brendan’s Parish has made. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the December meeting. Please keep the second recycling drop-off in the budget. Many of us on Mulberry Avenue use it every week.
Vera Murphy, Bellwood

articles.title: Stonebridge Asks Council for Speed Limit Change
articles.deck: The vote came after 23 residents spoke at Wednesday’s session.
body: Staff recommended approval with two conditions: a traffic study and a public notice period of 30 days. Public works estimates the work will take about 23 weeks once it starts in July.
The ordinance will return to the agenda at the next regular session, unless the chair calls a special meeting first.

articles.title: Edna Sokolov, 62, Playground Monitor
articles.deck: Friends remember Edna Sokolov for the many years of service to Hickory Ridge.
body: Edna Sokolov died in February at home on Ridge Drive, at the age of 62.
Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Eastgate Volunteer Fire Co. in his or her name.

Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Hickory Ridge. Born in Hickory Ridge in the years after the war, Edna Sokolov spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
